title: Evidence-Based Product Strategy for Biotech Startups
business: Biotech R&D teams and product managers
problem: Teams often waste months developing product features based on outdated or anecdotal market assumptions, leading to high opportunity costs and misaligned R&D investments.
solution: By integrating the Consensus plugin into the R&D workflow, teams can query a vast repository of 220M+ peer-reviewed papers to validate product hypotheses against current scientific consensus, ensuring development is grounded in verified evidence.
steps: Define the core product hypothesis or technical assumption regarding market viability.
Invoke the Consensus plugin within the ChatGPT interface to conduct a targeted search across peer-reviewed literature.
Synthesize the retrieved research findings into a structured summary to identify supporting or conflicting evidence.
Adjust the product roadmap based on the synthesized scientific insights to prioritize high-confidence features.
outcome: Improved alignment between R&D efforts and established scientific evidence, reducing the risk of pursuing scientifically unsupported product directions.
limitation: The plugin relies on the quality and breadth of the indexed peer-reviewed literature; it cannot account for proprietary data or unpublished industry trends, which should be verified by checking the source citations directly.
